description: Vendor Verification from Public Company Records — Resolve a vendor to a legal entity in official records, compare the claimed name, country and registration number, and find recent SEC filings when the filer matches. The report identifies conflicting details, close matches and source records.

domain.description: Company web domain; only used to guess a name and to prefer matching candidates. It is never fetched.

expected_country.description: Two-letter country in which the vendor says it is registered.

expected_name.description: Legal name on the vendor's registration or onboarding form.

expected_registry_id.description: Claimed company registration identifier, including leading zeros.

name.description: Company name, with or without legal form.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, matched case-insensitively against the SEC table.

country.description: VIES country code (Greece is EL, Northern Ireland XI).

number.description: VAT number without the country prefix.

name: vendor-verification
